g.text: U4: CH340B, VCC16 = V3-4 = +3V3; TNOW-15 and RST#-7 are unused.

g.desc: U4: CH340B, VCC16 = V3-4 = +3V3; TNOW-15 and RST#-7 are unused.

g.text: C9 (100nF) and C7 (4.7uF) are local bridge bypass capacitors.

g.desc: C9 (100nF) and C7 (4.7uF) are local bridge bypass capacitors.

g.text: DTR13 / RTS14 retain the two-transistor ESP8266 auto-reset.

g.desc: DTR13 / RTS14 retain the two-transistor ESP8266 auto-reset.

g.text: No crystal or VBUS sense divider required; RST# has an internal pull-up.

g.desc: No crystal or VBUS sense divider required; RST# has an internal pull-up.

g.text: Use esptool default reset; disable terminal hardware flow control.

g.desc: Use esptool default reset; disable terminal hardware flow control.

g.text: U4 = CH340B; no second USB bridge.

g.desc: U4 = CH340B; no second USB bridge.

g.text: Routed prototype PCB: review DRC and assembly before ordering.

g.desc: Routed prototype PCB: review DRC and assembly before ordering.

g.text: USB1 VBUS supplies +5V to U3 (3.3 V regulator).

g.desc: USB1 VBUS supplies +5V to U3 (3.3 V regulator).

g.text: CH340B VCC16 and V3-4 are tied to +3V3.

g.desc: CH340B VCC16 and V3-4 are tied to +3V3.

g.text: No external power input or CP2102N VBUS divider.

g.desc: No external power input or CP2102N VBUS divider.

g.text: Keep this ceramic-stable regulator with MLCC output capacitor C5.

g.desc: Keep this ceramic-stable regulator with MLCC output capacitor C5.

g.text: C5: 22uF 25V X5R Basic; account for DC-bias derating.

g.desc: C5: 22uF 25V X5R Basic; account for DC-bias derating.

g.text: Existing R5/R6: EN and GPIO0 pull-ups to 3.3 V.

g.desc: Existing R5/R6: EN and GPIO0 pull-ups to 3.3 V.

g.text: R5/R6 remain required even without manual boot/reset jumpers.

g.desc: R5/R6 remain required even without manual boot/reset jumpers.

g.text: DTR RTS | EN GPIO0 (physical logic levels)

g.desc: DTR RTS | EN GPIO0 (physical logic levels)
